newsitem.title: FRANCE: French government to replace Framatome chairman.
newsitem.headline: French government to replace Framatome chairman.

text.p: The French government said on Wednesday it was replacing the chairman of state-controlled nuclear plant maker Framatome, a week after he criticised a planned merger with Anglo-French engineering group GEC-Alsthom.

Industry minister Franck Borotra was asking Framatome's shareholders to appoint Dominique Vignon, currently the head of Framatome's nuclear activities, as chairman in place of Jean-Claude Leny who has reached maximum age, a statement said.
